February 4 33.

My dear Steptoe,

With reference to your letter of January 5,
1933, regarding a Communist named Haim Finkelstein
alias □□□ exhaustive inquiries have been made but
no confirmation could be obtained regarding the report
that he had been in China quite recently. The name
of this individual does not appear on the records of
the Municipal Police, the Chinese Passport Office or
the Russian Emigrants Committee.

Yours sincerely,
（签名）

H. E. Steptoe, Esq.,
British Consulate-General.

亲爱的斯蒂普托（Steptoe）：

关于您1933年1月5日来信，提及一名名为海姆·芬克尔斯坦（Haim Finkelstein）、化名□□□的共产党员，经详尽查询，未能证实有关他最近曾在中国的报告。此人的姓名未出现在工部局警务处、中国护照管理处或俄国侨民委员会的记录中。

REPORT
File No.

Date February 3, 1933.

Subject (in full) Enquiry from H.B.M. Consulate-General regarding
one Haim Finkelstein alias Burk.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky. Forwarded by [Signature]

With reference to the attached letter dated
January 8, 1933, from H.B.M. Consulate-General regarding
one Haim Finkelstein, who is stated to be an important
member of the Palestine Communist Party, I have to state
that diligent enquiries have failed to elicit any information
regarding this person. His name is unknown to the local
Chinese Passport Authorities and he has at no time been
registered with the Russian Emigrants Committee.

Particulars regarding Haim Finkelstein have
been added to the office record of suspects.

[Signature: g Tcheremshansky]
D. S.

Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题（全称） 英国驻华总领事馆就一名名为海姆·芬克尔斯坦（Haim Finkelstein）、化名伯克（Burk）之人进行的查询。

由 D.S. 切列姆尚斯基（Tcheremshansky）撰写。由 [签名] 转呈

关于附上的英国驻华总领事馆1933年1月8日来信，信中提及海姆·芬克尔斯坦（Haim Finkelstein），称其为巴勒斯坦共产党的重要成员，本人谨陈述，经勤勉查询，未能获取关于此人的任何信息。当地中国护照管理机关不知晓其姓名，且他从未在俄国侨民委员会登记。

关于海姆·芬克尔斯坦的详细情况已添加至本处的嫌疑人办公记录中。

[签名：g Tcheremshansky]
D. S.

特别处主管警官。

H.B.M. Consulate-General,
Shanghai.
5.1.33.

My dear Givens,

A certain Haim Finkelstein, an import-
ant and trusted member of the Palestine Communist
Party was arrested in Jaffa in 1930. He was in poss-
ession of a rather obscure map, which it was thought
might indicate the routes by which propaganda was dis-
tributed in Southern India and China.

Finkelstein was born at Kossov, Siedlce
Poland in 1903. He is 153 cms. in height, with blond
hair and brown eyes.

A man named Burk who is known to you
alias Finkelstein was recently in Vancouver, and it is
known that in conversation with certain members of the
Canadian Communist Party that unless the personnel
of that Party in Vancouver made good the subsidy to
it would be withdrawn. It is reported that Burk alias
Finkelstein was in China quite recently.

Have you any record of the man? and if

（批：5 feet 4 inches?）
（批：I use this）

1933年1月5日。

亲爱的吉文斯（Givens）：

某位海姆·芬克尔斯坦（Haim Finkelstein），系巴勒斯坦共产党重要且受信任的成员，于1930年在雅法（Jaffa）被捕。他持有一张相当晦涩难懂的地图，据信该地图可能标示了宣传品在南印度和中国分发的路线。

芬克尔斯坦于1903年出生在波兰谢德尔采省（Siedlce）的科索夫（Kossov）。他身高153厘米，金发，褐眼。

一个名叫伯克（Burk）的人，即您所知的芬克尔斯坦的化名，最近曾在温哥华，且据悉他在与加拿大共产党某些成员的谈话中表示，除非该党在温哥华的人员补足津贴，否则津贴将被撤回。据报道，化名为芬克尔斯坦的伯克最近曾在中国。

你们是否有此人的记录？如果有

（批注：5英尺4英寸？）
